body: Early scorecard: tama ang NEGATIVE opening call, at halos eksakto ang futures signal—Nikkei opened 1,019.91 points lower at 65,195.43. Mas mahalagang update: Reuters now shows the regional shock persisting, with Nikkei about -2.2%, Brent around $95.34 and U.S. 10Y near 4.80%. So far, oil → inflation/rates → tech-duration compression ang dominant chain. Hindi pa final verdict sa TOPIX-rotation thesis until we have reliable breadth/sector data later in the session.

sources.title: 日経平均は1019円安でスタート、住友鉱やソフトバンクGなどが下落／寄り付き概況
Asian markets tumble as US-Iran fighting lifts oil and bond yields

claims.text: Nikkei 225 opened September 2 at 65,195.43, down 1,019.91 points.
Reuters reported the Nikkei down about 2.2%, Brent at about $95.34 and the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield around 4.798% during Asian trading.

The pre-market oil-to-inflation/rates-to-tech-duration transmission thesis is supported by the early session, but the separate TOPIX breadth/rotation thesis remains untested without reliable current breadth data.
claims.basis: Inference comparing the published pre-market thesis with observed opening and cross-asset moves.
